shots.intent: Hook: the year 1993 slams onto a neon grid; lands on "1993". Slow push-in, excited mood.
Four voxel floppy disks stack up on a desk in Texas; the fourth lands on "four floppy disks". Camera cranes down.
The word DOOM punches in on "Doom", then "changed everything" shakes the frame.
A wireframe level assembles itself on "fake 3D world"; a ghost room above another room is crossed out on "no rooms above rooms".
Flat sectors light up one by one on "flat sectors"; a speed streak sweeps on "very fast renderer". Calm orbit through the pause.
Montage: calculator, printer and a pregnancy test each show the game, timed to "calculators", "printers" and "pregnancy tests".
Timeline 1993 to 1997; a source-code node opens on "released in 1997" and copies branch out.
A memory counter spins up and stops on 4 MB exactly on "4 megabytes". Push-in, satisfied ending.
